        row[f'{method}_count'] = sig_count
    
    # K = number of methods detecting each pair, then K_ge3, K_ge4
    # ...
    
    results.append(row)

| permg_rate | perm_granger significant / 8 |
| ty_rate | ty_granger significant / 8 |
| K_ge3 | ≥3 methods agree significant 的 pair 数 |
| K_ge4 | ≥4 methods agree significant 的 pair 数 |
| permg_count | perm_granger significant count (raw) |
